analysis.annotation_limit: Agent reference annotations can share model errors. Reports must not label them human ground truth.
analysis.p90: Use the nearest-rank value at ceil(0.90 * n) in ascending finite observations. Empty observations yield unknown.

paired_aggregation.cost_increase: For each comparable completed repeated low-risk pair, compute (P_estimated_api_equivalent_cost_usd - B1_estimated_api_equivalent_cost_usd) / B1_estimated_api_equivalent_cost_usd. Report the median ratio.
paired_aggregation.exclusions: Zero baseline denominators, missing data, failed work, and no-op work yield no ratio. Report every excluded row and planned coverage.
paired_aggregation.machine_increase: Use the same paired formula with observed machine elapsed seconds. Measure the critical path from admitted task start to final captured evidence. Include waits and remediation.
paired_aggregation.matching: Match repository, task, repetition, role assignment, source, acceptance, and qualified environment.
paired_aggregation.setup_clock: Count active operator setup, model correction, and baseline translation. Report machine wait separately. Never subtract unresolved or failed work.
paired_aggregation.setup_reduction: For each comparable completed pair, compute (baseline_active_setup_seconds - P_active_setup_seconds) / baseline_active_setup_seconds. Report the median ratio separately for B1 and B2.

primary_model_cost_metric.actual_cost: Report measured billed USD, estimates, subscription quota, and unknown usage in separate columns.
primary_model_cost_metric.categories: Use disjoint counters. Subtract cache reads and writes from inclusive input totals only when provider semantics prove that inclusion. Include reasoning in output when already charged there.
primary_model_cost_metric.formula: Sum (new_input_tokens * 2 + cache_read_tokens * 0.10 + five_minute_cache_write_tokens * 2.50 + output_tokens * 10) / 1000000 across all attempts.
primary_model_cost_metric.meaning: This metric estimates token-equivalent API cost. It does not measure subscription billing or quota.
primary_model_cost_metric.name: estimated_api_equivalent_cost_usd
primary_model_cost_metric.scope: Include implementation, review, remediation, failures, and interrupted attempts. Preserve each attempt and partial usage.
primary_model_cost_metric.unknown_rule: Unknown counter categories, unavailable usage, other cache tiers, or ambiguous overlap make this metric unknown. Never substitute zero.

analysis.small_sample_limit: Four held-out repositories support exploratory results only. No non-inferiority claim follows.

uncertainty.endpoints: Use nearest-rank 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of sorted resample statistics. Undefined resamples remain counted and excluded from interval endpoints. Report their number.
uncertainty.method: Repository-cluster percentile bootstrap. Sample repositories with replacement and retain their complete paired units. Recompute each median ratio.
uncertainty.small_sample: Four held-out clusters permit exploratory intervals only. No statistical non-inferiority claim follows.

analysis.undefined_metric: Report unknown when its denominator is zero or usage is unavailable.

blinding.annotation_access: Exclude reference annotations and condition labels from timed setup and grading bundles. Retain raw originals for later adjudication.
blinding.grader_identity_binding: Bind actual grader identities before Phase 3C. Human quality grading was not replaced by the annotation amendment.
procedure: Assign opaque result IDs before grading.
Remove condition names, runtime names, and implementation conversation from grading bundles.
Preserve the exact candidate, requirement, and captured check identities.
Use two independent human graders and attributed adjudication.
Record unavoidable clues and failed blinding.
Reveal the mapping only after grades and adjudication are fixed.

cache.baseline_configuration: B1 and B2 may reuse their own frozen configuration within repeated-task blocks. Count their setup and every later correction.
cache.cold_and_repeated: Report cold initialization separately. Amortize observed setup over 1, 5, and 20 tasks.
cache.local_dependencies: Use the same pinned read-only dependency snapshot. Separate writable caches per run.
cache.provider: Record unavoidable provider caching and category counters. Do not claim a cold provider cache without evidence.
cache.reuse: Only P may reuse its confirmed model within its defined repeated-task block. Record invalidation and every correction.
cache.workspace: Use a new source copy per run. Preserve no patch, session, review findings, or mutable state between conditions.

coverage.amendment: Agent annotation replaces human annotation. Explicit synthetic variants supplement missing stress features. All four real-repository stacks remain in denominators.
coverage.candidate_unfamiliarity: Current source copies and public inputs are new to this campaign. Global prior product use and predecessor-estate overlap remain unknown.
coverage.decision: Retain all four stacks and report unsupported cells. Do not replace real hold-outs with fixtures.
coverage.python_typescript: Core fixture evidence exists; platform and live conformance remain unavailable.
coverage.swift_dotnet: Discovery adapters and platform conformance remain unavailable.

design.ablations: No optional ablation runs are in this version. A later owner-approved version must define their shape and budget before exposure.
design.development_selection: Select these four repositories prospectively for calibration. Retain the other four for development preparation only.
design.development_selection_reason: The selection spans command-line, web, Swift package, and logging library structures. It uses no task outcome.
design.smaller_campaign: Require a new prospective shape and report the reduced power.

failure_accounting.retry_policy: No automatic coordinator retry. Record any later approved attempt separately.
rules: Create one record for every planned unit, including unsupported and unattempted units.
Preserve failed attempts and remediation histories. Never replace them with the final success.
Count blocked and unsupported units in total coverage. Report supported-case accuracy separately.
Require matching command, environment, and diagnostic identities for baseline-red comparisons.
Do not compare failed or no-op work as a cost saving over completed work.
Treat missing usage as unknown. Preserve partial usage after interruption.
Report product failures separately from task-quality failures.
A waiver preserves the missing gate. It does not create a passing observation.
Stop after a lost side-effect response. Reconcile operation identity before any approved retry.
failure_accounting.stopping: Stop on boundary failure, false completion, unavailable mandatory control, or exhausted approved resources.

freeze_boundary: Selected source-package inputs and analysis contracts are frozen. Actual native and platform qualification remains a distinct admission gate.

ordering.block_order: Sort blocks by the SHA-256 hex digest of block_key, then by block_key for ties.
ordering.blocking: Within each repository/task/repetition/role assignment, order all four conditions by that key.
ordering.encoding: UTF-8; decimal integers; no whitespace or trailing newline
ordering.export: Freeze the complete schedule and planned rows before the first run.
ordering.sort: Sort by SHA-256 hex digest, then by canonical key for ties.

owner_product_decision.ABANDON: Record absent setup value, absent B2 benefit, repeated false completion, unavailable enforcement, or excessive overhead.
owner_product_decision.GO: Require all prerequisite, discovery, setup, portability, quality, overhead, and B2 gates to pass.
owner_product_decision.MODIFY: Record limited value and a prospective narrower scope or integration proposal.
owner_product_decision.authority: Only the owner decides. Preserve every failed criterion.

spending.approval: The owner explicitly selected zero spending.
spending.enforcement: No evaluation process or inference may start with this zero allowance. Future nonzero exposure requires a separately approved exact budget.
spending.unknown_usage: Missing billing and quota observations remain unknown. A zero allowance does not imply zero historical or subscription consumption.

thresholds.approval: Owner delegated bounded selection. These values are fixed before sealed exposure.
thresholds.margin_interpretation: The 0.10 per-stack margin means ten percentage points. It is exploratory and is not a statistical non-inferiority margin.

values.B2_differentiation_rule: P must reduce median active setup time by at least 20% versus B2. It must retain the quality and overhead gates.
